what_it_is.prose: SCOPE is one of the in-house payloads Skyroot Aerospace carried on its Vikram-1 'Aagaman' maiden orbital flight of 18 July 2026, described in launch coverage as Skyroot's own satellite/payload for performance assessment. Public evidence is limited to brief mentions within the Vikram-1 manifest, so this remains an honest compact stub pending a primary technical description.
